QUOTE: The library spawns no threads. The four spawn sites the index found are all in `programs/`... The lock functions are function pointers (`threading.c`), defaulting to pthread. `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` replaces them.

VERDICT: HIT

WHY: The answer says the library spawns no threads (spawn sites are only in programs/), and it also says library/ provides the mutex abstraction (threading.c lock function pointers, with the mutexes used by threaded callers).
